name: expense-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Emails the employee when their claim is approved or rejected.

description: Owns expense claims and the team weekly limit. Stores each claim's amount, receipt reference, merchant, date, category and status; lets an employee submit and track their own claims; lets a manager list, approve and reject their team's claims and set/read the team's weekly limit. Does not read receipt images or interpret natural language itself — expense-webapp calls the agents for that and sends this service only the resulting structured values. Exposed to the internet because the browser SPA calls it directly.
